Set in the opulent yet treacherous inner court of ancient China, a clever young maiden gifted with an extensive knowledge of poisons finds herself working as a low-ranking servant in the emperor's harem. When the imperial heirs begin falling ill to mysterious ailments, her insatiable curiosity and rare immunity to toxins drive her to secretly investigate the palace's darkest secrets. Navigating dangerous political intrigues and court conspiracies, she uses her eccentric expertise to solve baffling crimes while trying to keep a low profile.
